value.rationale: A widely used spacing-based goodness-of-fit test currently uses simulation fitted extreme quantiles; this resolves its natural fixed-n far-tail asymptotic with a positive computable constant and proves an exact exponential-moment boundary. Identifying two and only two dominating endpoint cluster strata is substantive, and the bounded-score lower-tail equivalent is directly relevant to rare-event p-value calibration. No finite-x accuracy guarantee or all-n uniformity is asserted.
